provenance.encodes: Qatar legislation convention: Law No. N of YYYY; Emiri Decree No. N of YYYY (Al Meezan legal portal)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open almeezan.qa for any law and read its heading 'Law No. (N) of YYYY'; compare to OSCOLA International Citation of Qatar.

positive.text: See Qatar Law No. 13 of 2000 on foreign capital.
Emiri Decree No. 6 of 2000 and Law No. 22 of 2004 (Qatar) apply.
Qatari Decree-Law No. 19 of 2006 was amended.
Qatar Amiri Decree No. 6 of 2000 applies.

note: Bare 'Law No. N of YYYY' and bare 'Amiri Decree' (Kuwait uses the same title) are rejected unless Qatar-qualified (prefix or '(Qatar)' suffix). Bare 'Emiri Decree' is the Qatari spelling and is kept.
